tools.what: runs a whole edrun run list without a claude session: dry check of every line, then games queued over free instances (never 0) by RAM, control reruns; test: tools/edrun/test/runlist-test.js

tools.name: bootcheck
tools.run: node tools/bootcheck/bootcheck.js [--exe as64|mowas_2|mowas2|goh] base <game.log> [--to-clock] [-o base.json] | mod <game.log> --base base.json [--to-clock] [--mod name] [--options options.set] [--report report.json] [-o out.json] | spawn <game.log|report.json> --list units.txt [-o out.json]
tools.what: game from --exe, else goh for a GoH-form log, else as64 (a mowas_2 log needs --exe mowas2); non-AS64 bases carry game, base/<map>.<game>.json; GoH mod from Mod: activate mod; spawn refused for mowas2 (ENG-19, MIS-12), GoH = bot purchase lines; deterministic in-game verdicts from recorded logs only (no game start, no clock): base = error and warning lines of a vanilla run, normalized and counted by key; mod PASS = 0 new error lines vs the base + the run reached the clock (+ mod active with --mod); spawn PASS = one spawn line per listed unit, names the missing

tools.name: exam
tools.run: node tools/exam/draw.js --seed N --groups <groups json|csv> [--per 1] [--rounds 4] [--eligible units.json|.txt] [--pairs-src file|dir] [--control pair.json] [--per-game 7] [--insts 2,3] [--mods as64+,<mod>] [--secs 75] [--donors build.json] [--out dir] [--dry] [--exe as64] [--game G]
tools.what: --game default from lib/gamedir; --exe mowas2|goh refused, exit 2; seeded exam draw: one rep per unit group, uniform over the eligible members (not sweep-pass-first); writes edrun pair lists per round and units.json for unitmod; same seed = same draw

tools.name: gemindex
tools.run: node tools/gemindex/gemindex.js
tools.what: offline search of the GEM External Index (9,346 links, 934 guides, 160 tools, 1,729 saved pages, 40 FAQ); search/show/sources/faq/tools/gaps/export/stats offline, scrape/wayback (public pages, robots.txt obeyed, one page at a time) and extract, bundle/scan for the release folder; search --game as2rel|gohrel (gohrel = goh, cta, gem2, all); data via --data/GEM_INDEX_DIR or gemindex/ beside the exe, never in repo; GUI page 'Guides and tools' (ext guides)
